mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal ( meal_date, total_kcal, point, is_recommendation, user_id, meal_type_id, meal_creator_type_id ) VALUES ( #{mealDate}, #{totalKcal}, #{point}, #{isRecommendation}, #{userId}, #{mealTypeId}, #{mealCreatorTypeId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE meal SET meal_date = #{mealDate}, total_kcal = #{totalKcal}, point = #{point}, is_recommendation = #{isRecommendation}, user_id = #{userId}, meal_type_id = #{mealTypeId}, meal_creator_type_id = #{mealCreatorTypeId} WHERE meal_id = #{mealId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM meal WHERE meal_creator_type_id = 2 ORDER BY meal_date DESC, meal_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
